info.title: GadgetVault API
info.description:
Single-vendor e-commerce API for SEN371.

Every response uses one envelope: `{ success, data, error, meta }`. Errors set `success: false` and carry `error.code`, `error.message` and, for validation failures, `error.details` naming each offending field.

Money is always an integer number of cents.

**Authentication.** `POST /auth/login` returns an access token; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie scoped to `/api/auth` and never appears in a response body. Use the **Authorize** button above to try protected endpoints.

**Rate limits.** 300 requests / 15 min per IP across the API, 60 / 15 min on writes, 10 / 15 min on login.

password.description: At least 8 characters and at least one digit.

201.description: Created. A refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie.

post.description: Rate limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP. A wrong password and an unknown address return the same message, so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate registered emails.
Reads the httpOnly refresh cookie, issues a new access token and rotates the refresh cookie. Logging out invalidates every outstanding refresh token.
Invalidates every outstanding refresh token for this user by bumping their token version.

get.description: Returns the caller's own account, re-read from the database rather than decoded from the token, so a role change or a deactivation takes effect on the next call. The client uses this on every page load to restore a session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 100 - an unbounded limit is a denial-of-service lever.

post.description: Only fields declared by a validation rule are persisted, so unknown keys such as ratingAverage cannot be set by the client.

delete.description: A soft delete - isActive becomes false. Orders referencing the product keep their snapshot.

get.description: Paginated, and returns meta, so the shape matches products and orders.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 100 - an unbounded limit is a denial-of-service lever.

delete.description: Refused with 422 while products still reference the category.

post.summary: Add an item, or increase its quantity
post.description: The stock check uses the resulting quantity, not just the amount added.

patch.summary: Set the quantity of a line

post.description: Decrements stock atomically, builds the order from server-calculated totals, then authorises the card with the payment provider. The amount sent is always the calculated total, never a figure from the request body. A decline or an unreachable provider rolls stock back and leaves the cart intact.

201.description: Paid. The order carries a paymentReference.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 100 - an unbounded limit is a denial-of-service lever.

get.summary: Get one of the user's own orders
get.description: Ownership is re-checked against the authenticated user, not taken from the URL.
Revenue, orders, customers and conversion with 7-day series for sparklines, plus low-stock products and the most recent orders. Revenue counts only paid, shipped and delivered orders.
The storefront list hides inactive products; this one does not, so an admin can find and reactivate something they soft-deleted. Includes stockQty.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 100 - an unbounded limit is a denial-of-service lever.

get.description: By id rather than slug, because the edit form has the id and a deactivated product is not reachable by slug.

patch.description: Restock from the dashboard's low-stock panel. The decrement is conditional, so stock can never be driven below zero.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Capped at 100 - an unbounded limit is a denial-of-service lever.

patch.description: Allowed moves: pending to paid or cancelled; paid to shipped or cancelled; shipped to delivered. Anything else is 422. Cancelling returns stock.

message.example: Price must be a non-negative integer

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token is set separately as an httpOnly cookie and never appears in a response body.

CategoryRef.description: The product's category, flattened - never the full category document.

inStock.description: Derived from stockQty. The exact count is admin-only.

slug.description: Optional - derived from the name when omitted.

Cart.description: Totals are recomputed on every read from live product prices; they are never stored on the cart.

Card.description: Forwarded to the payment provider and never stored. Only the last four digits are logged.

OrderItem.description: A price snapshot taken at checkout - a later price change never rewrites an order.

paymentReference.description: The payment provider's reference. Null until the payment is approved.

BadRequest.description: Validation failed. `error.details` names each offending field.

Unauthorized.description: No access token, or it is expired or malformed.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not allowed to do this.

error.message: You do not have permission to do that

Conflict.description: A unique value is already taken.

error.message: That value is already in use

UnprocessableEntity.description: Well-formed, but a business rule refuses it.

error.message: Not enough stock for Aurora Mechanical Keyboard

PaymentDeclined.description: The provider answered, and declined the card. Stock is rolled back and the cart is left intact.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. See `RateLimit-*` response headers.

error.message: Too many requests - please slow down and try again shortly

ServiceUnavailable.description: The payment provider could not be reached. Stock is rolled back; the card was not charged.

error.message: The payment provider is not responding - your card has not been charged

ServerError.description: Unexpected failure. No stack trace is included when NODE_ENV=production.
